conditions.description: Applications must be submitted jointly by the researcher and a beneficiary organisation in the academic or non-academic sector.
European Postdoctoral Fellowships are open to researchers of any nationality.
Global Postdoctoral Fellowships are restricted to European nationals or long-term residents of EU Member States or Horizon Europe Associated Countries.
The host organisation for the mandatory return phase of a Global Postdoctoral Fellowship must be established in an EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country.
Eligible countries for beneficiary organisations are described in Annex B of the Work Programme General Annexes.
European Fellowship standard duration: between 12 and 24 months.
Global Fellowship outgoing phase duration: minimum 12 months, maximum 24 months in a non-associated Third Country; return phase: mandatory 12 months at host in EU Member State or Associated Country.

Non-academic placement (if included) must be at an organisation from the non-academic sector established in an EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country; for non-academic sector fellows, it must be at a different non-academic organisation.
conditions.source_section: Scope - Placements in the non-academic sector

conditions.description: Organisations active in nuclear research established in EU Member States or Euratom-associated countries are eligible for MSCA-PF in Euratom research areas.
Financial and operational capacity requirements are described in Annex C of the Work Programme General Annexes.
conditions.source_section: Financial and Operational Capacity and Exclusion

conditions.description: The indicative call budget for 2026 is EUR 59,857,539; no per-project maximum EU contribution is stated in the available call extract documents.

Admissibility conditions including proposal page limits and layout are described in Annex A and Annex E of the General Annexes and in Part B of the Application Form available in the Submission System.
Open access requirements and associated conditions apply as per the Horizon Europe programme framework.
conditions.inference_note: The scope text mandates that training foster 'opening access to publications and to other research outputs including data, FAIR data management' and 'opening science and research to citizens', which implies Horizon Europe open access obligations apply to MSCA-PF outputs. The specific conditions are governed by the General Annexes not available in declared inputs.
